name: Commandeer Hellmouth

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: Your folio contains a contract with one of the hellmouths, enormous living portals connected to Hell itself. You can cast a 6th-rank Teleport once per day as a divine innate spell. By spending 8 hours poring over your contracts, you can instead cast Interplanar Teleport but can only travel to Hell (and not back).
